unsupported: GlobalFoundries is headquartered in Essex Junction, Vermont, and was founded in 2009 as a joint venture between Mubadala Investment Company and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) to address growing global demand for advanced semiconductors.

The company's global headquarters and most advanced fabrication facility are located in Malta, New York, with additional manufacturing sites in Burlington, Vermont; Dresden, Germany; Singapore; and Guangzhou, China.
The company operates as a pure-play semiconductor foundry, providing end-to-end manufacturing services from chip design through wafer fabrication, assembly, and test.
The Malta fab is a highly automated 300 mm facility; the Burlington site specializes in RF and GaN; Dresden and Singapore provide high-volume production for long-lifecycle applications.

Known for: Flexible global footprint with fabs on four continents; Differentiated portfolio including FD-SOI, RF-SOI, silicon photonics, and advanced packaging; Over 600 qualified test solutions and vetted OSAT partner network; 25+ years of RF testing leadership; Trusted supplier for ITAR-regulated aerospace and defense programs
